title: The effective rule set, resolved
intro: rules reads the vendored baseline and the project rules as one additive set, resolves their dependencies in a deterministic order, and shows any one of them whole.

scenarios.title: The resolved order
scenarios.explain: Every active rule, its version, its class and where it came from. A missing dependency or a cycle would refuse the whole set rather than apply part of it.

scenarios.title: One rule, whole
scenarios.explain: Front matter and body, from the file the repository carries. The rule is the document; the tool only finds it.

scenarios.title: A rule that is not in the set
scenarios.explain: Exit 12, a missing artifact, with the command that lists what exists.
